results.title: Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi
results.overview: Putri had run away from home about a year prior. When she was finally found by her mother, Mak Elli, and her younger sister, Alana, Putri was ill following childbirth; she had originally fled after becoming pregnant by her boyfriend. Mak Elli insisted that Putri and her baby, Raman, return home to reunite with the family. After moving back, however, Putri’s condition deteriorated, and she passed away. Since then, local residents have complained about sightings of Putri’s wandering spirit, which appears to be lingering as if there is unfinished business.

results.title: Chelot
results.overview: A special operations police officer becomes an informant for a crime syndicate to overcome financial hardship and save his family, but his desperate decision puts their lives in danger.

results.title: Notre fils
results.overview: The obstacle-strewn journey of Romain and Antoine, a homosexual couple, involved in a long and difficult adoption process. After five years of waiting, they see their adoption application stalled for largely societal reasons: the system's reluctance to place children with a male couple, particularly in so-called “late” adoptions. Despite their sincere love and deep desire to become parents, they encounter prejudice, such as being required to prove the presence of female role models in their social circle.

results.title: The Eyes of Others
results.overview: In the untamed beauty of the island owned by an extraordinarily wealthy Marquis, Elena's arrival marks the beginning of a passionate love affair. Complicity and transgression, sex and power, in a film inspired by 1960s Italian true crime, where erotic play unfolds into obsession.

results.title: Blood Red
results.overview: A discontented vampire couple decide to exchange their ancient, eternal boredom for the chance to live a brief but vivid human existence.

results.title: Her in Frame
results.original_title: Her in Frame เธอในภาพนั้น
results.overview: Inspired by the love story of King Bhumibol Adulyadej and Queen Sirikit, the movie follows a young photographer and a textile museum curator who connect through a mysterious vintage photograph.

results.title: Love Insurance Kompany
results.overview: In 2040, an app premised on ensuring romance for all is used widely by the population. When the voice behind the app's AI realizes its misconception to true love, he embarks on a quest to prove that love does not come from a screen.

results.title: The Hunt
results.overview: A fading influencer stages a fake serial killer live stream at a remote Texas property, recruiting a quiet caretaker to play along-until performance becomes permission and the staged horror turns brutally real.

results.title: One Night at KitKat
results.overview: Berlin, Saturday night. Behind the doors of the legendary KitKatClub, a world unfolds that usually remains hidden. In a place where mobile phones are strictly forbidden, a camera was allowed inside. The founding duo looks back on the origins of the club—a venue that, like few others, epitomizes Berlin’s club culture, techno, the fetish scene, and sex-positive parties. Guests and staff share stories of self-acceptance, body positivity, and community. Intimate, unfiltered, and non-judgmental, the documentary offers an exclusive glimpse into a night at the KitKat.

results.title: Becaària
results.overview: 1977. Sixteen-year-old Mario lives in a small village in Ticino, Italian-speaking Switzerland. While society around him is shifting in many ways, he experiences his first awkward sentimental approaches, has trouble in school, and constantly clashes with a father who doesn’t seem to get him.

results.title: A Room Called Home
results.overview: Set in an old apartment complex where a family lives in a single cramped room, Nhà Ba Tôi Một Phòng portrays the “out-of-sync” relationship between a conservative father and his dream-filled Gen Z daughter. As generational differences collide within the confined space, their bond is tested and gradually mended. The film offers an intimate slice of contemporary Vietnamese family life, where love often begins with understanding.

results.title: Centrífuga
results.overview: Maca is leaving in a week to study abroad away from her city, Seville. What she once envisioned as the future is now an imminent reality. Maca's inertia suddenly stops after having to face a host of new fears that will falter the decision that was once firm.

results.title: La llegenda del Canyut
results.overview: The plot revolves around the mythical figure of Canyut, a central character whose mysterious legend resurfaces year after year along the coast.

results.title: Ikkis
results.overview: Second Lieutenant and India's youngest Param Vir Chakra recipient, Arun Khetarpal, gave his life fighting for his battalion and the country during the 1971 Battle of Basantar. Ikkis also takes a reflective look at the futility of war through the eyes of Khetarpal's father, who visits his ancestral home in Sargodha and Alma Mater for reunion, which now happens to be in post-partition Pakistan, 30 years later.

results.title: Artichoke
results.overview: Held captive in a violent relationship, Cynara discovers a phoropter that opens a portal to another world. In a terrifying cat-and-mouse chase between realities, Cynara finally comes face to face with her oppressor and must decide what she’s willing to destroy in order to survive.

results.title: The 3 Killer Pigs
results.overview: A local farmer is desperate and does the unthinkable in his attempt to get his precious livestock back. A blood oath is put in place when the killer pigs make their way back to where their nightmare began. Darkness shrouds the farmhouse and its occupants when the three piggies come home.

results.title: Inolvidable Heidi
results.overview: Heidi, a magical girl from the mountains who lives with her grandfather, her friends, and her rabbit Nicanor, captivates Franco, a young man from the city, with her natural charm. Franco begins sneaking away from his girlfriend, his friends, and even his teacher, just to go see this mountain girl who has stolen his heart. Despite the difficulties and his girlfriend’s interference, their love blossoms. However, an accident and a spell cause them to forget their love. Years later, fate brings them together again. They don’t remember each other, but the same love still lies dormant within them. A love story that defies memory and endures through time.

results.title: Who Killed Alex Odeh?
results.overview: In October 1985, Santa Ana, California was shaken by a brazen act of political violence when Palestinian American Alex Odeh, a beloved teacher and community leader, was killed by a tripwire bomb planted in his office. Despite substantial evidence and identified suspects, the case was never solved. Who Killed Alex Odeh? reopens the mystery, tracking a renewed investigation in real time as new leads emerge, long-buried records come to light, and the forces behind a political assassination are finally confronted.

results.title: The Convenience Store
results.overview: Yukino, a part-time worker at a convenience store, and the strange experience she has when she encounters a mysterious customer in the middle of the night.
